documented_scope: anchors accumulate within one helper process; a long-lived process reusing a single helper would need per-host isolation that this path does not attempt

finding.claim_removed: a fresh database per call keeps anchors from one host out of another
finding.description: the code created a fresh NSS database directory for every chain check, implying per-call isolation, but NSS can only be initialised once per process, so anchors imported on the first exchange remain for the life of the helper process
why_it_still_passes: the helper is a short-lived per-request subprocess, so the process lifetime is the request
four sequential anchored exchanges in one context all returned their own peer body

still_open: per-host anchor isolation for a reused long-lived helper
